implemented_family.source: fnto_rule57/r57_model.py Transport.coefficients/apply + fnto_persist59/runtime.py P state (encoder Linear(16,32) on node[:, :16], two residual message layers); 157,024 parameters
implemented_family.probe_response: scatter[a,j,o,c] = d[i,a] sum_r A[r,a,c] T[j,r,c] O[r,o,c] with d = 1 - beta_model (geometry-only q=256 zero-collision quadrature, not learned)
implemented_family.A: softmax(in_logits, dim mixture): 8x16 per channel, strictly positive, every incoming-bin column sums to 1; one global matrix for all ports and geometries
implemented_family.O: softmax(out_logits, dim outgoing bin): every mixture is a strictly positive probability distribution over 64 outgoing bins; one global matrix
implemented_family.T: T[j,r,c] = sum_{e: src=i,dst=j} W[e,r,c] + sum_k U[j,k,r,c] V[i,k,r,c]; W = softplus(edge MLP(src_layer(z_i)+dst_layer(z_j)+pair_layer(pair_ij))) * prior_c(dist) on the 128 nearest rest-coordinate neighbours (per-channel decay lengths 18.1/5.8/1.8 mm); U = softmax over ALL destination ports (rank 16 per mixture/channel, per geometry); V = softplus; mass = sigmoid; W and V rescaled so sum_j T[j,r,c] = mass[i,r,c] in (0,1)
implemented_family.passivity: column sum = beta + (1-beta) sum_r A[r,a,c] mass[i,r,c] < 1 for every parameter value; T >= 0, O > 0, A > 0, output >= 0
implemented_family.geometry_conditioning: all spatial coefficients are functions of the current 16 local node features (two-hop message passing), pair geometry and the fixed prior; A and O do not depend on geometry
implemented_family.ballistic: B x is geometry-only and not learned; one-hot scatter is linear in the remaining budget d
implemented_family.lifecycle: experimental copies only; production checkpoints are read, never written

wl66_relaxations: Relaxed rank-8 floor: any shared 1-containing 8-dim incoming subspace with SIGNED, unconstrained (space x outgoing) response. Forbidden by the family: negative coefficients, non-simplex A, response rows that are not convex combinations of 8 nonnegative rank-1 (space x outgoing) fields with GLOBAL outgoing lobes.
Frozen A floor: frozen A but arbitrary signed response per bin. Forbidden: signed/unconstrained outgoing structure, mass > 1.
Frozen A+O floor: frozen A and O with free SIGNED spatial coefficients t_rj. Forbidden: t_rj < 0, sum_j t_rj >= 1, spatial coefficients not produced by the geometry-conditioned network.
None of the WL66 floors is constrained by the network map from geometry to coefficients.
coefficient_class: FCoef: global simplex A/O (logit-parameterised), per-source T >= 0 with sum_j T = sigmoid(mass) < 1. With 4 probe sources per geometry and rank 16 >= 4, the closure of the network family's response set on the probe population is contained in FCoef; FCoef removes only geometry conditioning/parameter sharing of the spatial coefficients.

heldout_references.estimator: unchanged WL66 estimator: WL57 first-exit importance action with the one-hot proposal, fast walker, WL63 observational zero-collision/collided tags (tag_reference.py)
heldout_references.seed_formula: 683000000 + geometry_index*100000 + slot*10000 + bin*100 + replica (geometry order above); smoke 688000000 + worker*10 + k (non-evidence)
heldout_references.budget_rule: Preflight times each configuration with non-evidence smoke packets (2 per worker, rest, slot 0). The configuration with the highest measured packets/hour is used. K = 8 replicas if 256 probes x 8 packets are predicted to take <= max_hours, else K = 4 if <= max_hours, else STOP_RESOURCE. budget.json is committed before generation.
heldout_references.chunk_note: The action chunk only partitions photons into independent batches of the same estimator; per-packet seeds make results independent of worker assignment.

objective.name: diagnostic physical fitting objective J (existence probe; not a training recipe)
objective.definition: J = mean over geometry (rest, pt0), probe source (4) and channel of [ mean over spaces {native 3840x64, fine16 3840x16, coarse 240x16} of |S_hat - S|^2 / |S|^2 + |H D^-1 (S_hat - S)|^2 / |H D^-1 S|^2 in coarse ]; S = mean of fitting replicas 0-3 of the collided (scattered) first-exit response; D = model budget 1-beta per bin; H = I - 11'/16 over incoming bins
objective.note: Ballistic B is geometry-only and not fitted. Absolute and directional-contrast terms are each normalised per matrix and channel.

net.algorithm: Adam (betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8), full batch (2 geometries x 4 sources x 16 bins), float32, TF32 off

optimizer.convergence_definition: |mean J over the last 10% of logged steps - mean J over the preceding 10%| / mean J(last 10%) < 0.01; fixed step count, no early stopping, final iterate kept

run_groups.net: every parameter except in/out logits (spatial coefficients and geometry conditioning)

T1.note: known admissible member: the other WL59 seed

T2.note: P_5902 network with A/O logits of the physical coefficient-level restart with the lowest final training objective: a known admissible member whose angular bases differ from WL59's

Tcoef.note: random global A/O logits N(0,1), spatial T of P_5902; coefficient-optimizer control

cvx_J_5901.note: frozen WL59 A,O; best admissible native spatial coefficients (T>=0, sum_j T<=1) under J

cvx_conAO_5901.note: frozen A,O, nonnegative capped coarse spatial coefficients, coarse contrast only: admissible counterpart of WL66 PAOc

cvx_conA_5901.note: frozen A, nonnegative capped per-cell (mixture x outgoing) blocks, coarse contrast only: admissible counterpart of WL66 F_A with free outgoing

oracle.label: angular-transfer ORACLE: admissible spatial coefficients fitted on the first K/2 held-out replicas (first 1 if K<6), scored on the remaining replicas, for fixed A/O of frozen 5901/5902, the primary candidate and the best coefficient-level restart. Uses held-out references; never a candidate.

metrics.rho: sqrt(E/S) per channel, pooled over matrices: E unbiased cross-replica error energy, S unbiased signal energy; jackknife over replicas, 95% t bounds; criteria use the upper bound
metrics.con: directional contrast H D^-1 (WL66 Z normalisation)
metrics.also: per-matrix values, per-probe (bin) relative error, Pair7 bins (8,13), energy ratios, signed deformation (Delta_k = R(geometry)_k - R(rest)_k), corr/slope, fixed-basis floors (L7, F_A, PAOc) for every candidate's A/O, WL59 original extended-field metrics for every network candidate

quality.source: WL59 original thresholds: coarse mean relative L2 0.10, fine16 0.15, directional pair relative L2 0.25
quality.apply: all three channels, upper 95% bound, pooled per group over precision-qualified matrices

teacher.apply: noise-free student vs teacher, each fit geometry and channel; informative iff the initial student error exceeds an informative threshold somewhere

decision.primary_candidate: the physical net/all run (net_all_5901, net_all_5902, net_all_scratch6801) with the lowest final TRAINING objective J; all runs reported
decision.S_fit: quality criteria hold for the primary candidate on the fit population, separately for rest and pt0 (eval replicas 4-7)
decision.S_gen: quality criteria hold for the primary candidate on every held-out group H1_rest, H1_pt0, H2, H3
decision.optimizer_adequate: at least one informative net teacher control (T1, T1r, T2) exists and every informative one passes
decision.outcome: A if S_fit and S_gen; B if S_fit and not S_gen; C if not S_fit and optimizer_adequate and the primary candidate converged; else D
decision.family_status: A: still a viable candidate on the tested population; B: needs a specific additional falsification (independent generalization); C: unsupported for the tested physical requirements (constructive attainment failed; impossibility not established); D: needs a specific additional falsification (representation vs optimization/reference not separated)
decision.attribution_descriptive: convex frozen-basis floors vs WL66 signed floors (what the relaxations permitted); A/O/AO/net groups (angular alignment vs spatial/geometry conditioning); coefficient class FCoef vs network (geometry conditioning); Tcoef (coefficient optimizer); angular-transfer oracle on held-out (bases vs spatial generalization)

reading held-out references in any fit
